title: Sukkah 8b — Practice Quiz
source: Questions and correct answers taken directly from the Dafyomi Advancement Forum quiz for Sukkah 8 (dafyomi.co.il/sukah/quiz/su-qz-008.htm), questions 5–6.

questions.q: A potter's hut has an inner and outer room. What is their status regarding mezuzah?
questions.explain: The inner room is lived in year-round (a real house, needing a mezuzah, but not a valid sukkah); the outer room is just a passage/shop-front (a valid sukkah, exempt from mezuzah).

questions.q: What does GaNBaKh have going for it that RaKBaSh doesn't, as far as sukkah is concerned?
options: It comes first in alphabetical order
It is a more solid (permanent-feeling) dwelling
The people who use those booths are obligated in sukkah
questions.explain: GaNBaKh's cases (gentile, woman, animal, Samaritan) are sturdy, permanent-style structures, which is why that Tanna finds them obviously valid first — even though none of their builders were obligated in the mitzvah. RaKBaSh's cases have the opposite going for them: their builders were obligated, even though the structures are only seasonal.
